user_saw: Codex turns failed when the macOS sandbox blocked `/bin/ps`, and automatic setup could select Ollama without surfacing the Codex error.
summary: The fix uses native process inspection for Codex on macOS Bun and surfaces Codex detection and inspection errors during automatic setup.
reasoning: I checked that #132610 made `execFile("ps", …)` part of mandatory Codex startup registration, where it worked on hosts that allowed `ps`. The documented failure occurs in the signed standalone Bun deployment added by #172384 when Seatbelt denies that executable. I also checked #169628, whose initial automatic setup loop continued to the next candidate after a Codex activation error, explaining the separate Ollama fallback symptom.
